notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Scuttling Sliver.
Scuttling Sliver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scuttling Sliver by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
